findings.text: Task view selection exposes three debugger perspectives. When the tracing process itself runs in compat mode it receives the compact 32-bit view, when only the target thread is compat it receives the extended ptrace view with extra access, otherwise it receives the native 64-bit view.
Native ptrace entry intercepts memory tagging operations for dedicated handling and delegates every other request to the generic ptrace dispatcher.

Compat ptrace entry serves 32-bit clients. It handles PTRACE_PEEKUSR and PTRACE_POKEUSR for user area access, COMPAT_PTRACE_GETREGS and COMPAT_PTRACE_SETREGS for general state, COMPAT_PTRACE_GET_THREAD_AREA for thread storage, COMPAT_PTRACE_SET_SYSCALL for syscall number, COMPAT_PTRACE_GETVFPREGS and COMPAT_PTRACE_SETVFPREGS for vector state, plus COMPAT_PTRACE_GETHBPREGS and COMPAT_PTRACE_SETHBPREGS for hardware breakpoints when that option is enabled, delegating any other request to generic compat handling.

Guarded control stack state is exchanged as a record holding enabled features, locked features and stack pointer, with user fields features_enabled features_locked gcspr_el0 mirrored to thread fields gcs_el0_mode gcs_el0_locked gcspr_el0 in both directions.

Guarded control stack register access requires platform support signalled by system_supports_gcs, otherwise rejected as invalid. Reads targeting the current task first synchronize state via gcs_preserve_current_state. Writes validate enabled bits against PR_SHADOW_STACK_SUPPORTED_STATUS_MASK and reject out of mask values.

Native table enumerates general, floating, TLS, breakpoint, watchpoint, syscall, mode, vector and authentication slots in fixed order with conditional compilation gating vector and security features. General uses PRSTATUS, floating uses PRFPREG, TLS uses ARM_TLS, debug uses ARM_HW_BREAK and ARM_HW_WATCH, syscall uses ARM_SYSTEM_CALL, mode uses ARM_FPMR, vector family uses ARM_SVE ARM_SSVE ARM_ZA ARM_ZT, authentication uses ARM_PAC_MASK ARM_PAC_ENABLED_KEYS plus checkpoint slots ARM_PACA_KEYS ARM_PACG_KEYS, with ARM_TAGGED_ADDR_CTRL ARM_POE ARM_GCS for tagging overlay and guarded stack. Each entry derives count from its user structure and aligns to element width, with the mask slot read only.
Native view is published as aarch64 with EM_AARCH64 and spans the entire native table with automatically derived length.

Compat general view maps indexes 15 16 17 to program counter, converted status and original syscall argument, with remaining indexes passed through. Conversions use pstate_to_compat_psr and compat_psr_to_pstate between pstate and compat status. Writes assemble a shadow copy from pc pstate orig_x0 and general array regs and commit only when valid_user_regs accepts the result.

Compat vector access requires system_supports_fpsimd and synchronizes current state via fpsimd_preserve_current_state before reads. Packed storage sized by VFP_STATE_SIZE is moved as a block while fpscr is synthesized from fpsr masked by VFP_FPSCR_STAT_MASK combined with fpcr masked by VFP_FPSCR_CTRL_MASK, split back on writes, followed by fpsimd_flush_task_state.
Compat thread storage exposes tp_value from the user thread area as a single compat word, readable directly and replaceable via partial updates.

Two 32-bit views share EM_ARM under name aarch32. Compact core view provides REGSET_COMPAT_GPR sized by COMPAT_ELF_NGREG with PRSTATUS and REGSET_COMPAT_VFP sized from VFP_STATE_SIZE with ARM_VFP. Extended ptrace view reuses native positions to add single entry ARM_TLS alongside PRSTATUS ARM_VFP ARM_HW_BREAK ARM_HW_WATCH and ARM_SYSTEM_CALL.

Compat user reads require word alignment and treat COMPAT_PT_TEXT_ADDR COMPAT_PT_DATA_ADDR COMPAT_PT_TEXT_END_ADDR as code start, data start and code end from memory management state. Offsets inside the general register window return mapped registers, trailing space up to COMPAT_USER_SZ returns zero, and larger offsets fail.

Compat user writes require word alignment inside COMPAT_USER_SZ. Stores at or beyond the general register set size succeed without effect. Other positions update program counter, converted status or syscall argument and general entries in a shadow copy that commits only after validation.

Compat hardware breakpoint numbering encodes type and field in sign and parity. Zero addresses resource description, negative values use NT_ARM_HW_WATCH and positive values use NT_ARM_HW_BREAK, with odd values selecting address and even values selecting control for an index derived from request magnitude.
Resource description packs four bytes from most to least significant as monitor architecture version, fixed watchpoint length of eight, watchpoint slot count and breakpoint slot count.
Reserved-zero mask for 64-bit status spans bits 63 through 32, 27 through 26, 23 through 22, 20 through 13, and bit 5; the 32-bit form spans bits 63 through 32 plus bits 22 and 20.
Syscall tracing direction distinguishes PTRACE_SYSCALL_ENTER from PTRACE_SYSCALL_EXIT with entry ordered first.
Relocation self test expects absolute symbols to resolve to 64-bit value ffff880000cccccc hex, 32-bit value f800cccc hex and 16-bit value f8cc hex.

Relocation validation pairs each supported relocation mnemonic with an accessor routine and its expected result, covering absolute data widths, signed and unsigned wide immediate construction, page and short range PC relative forms including a far kernel symbol, and PC relative data widths. Initialization invokes each accessor, logs name with returned value and pass or fail outcome, and reports mismatches with expected versus observed values, while exit performs no action.

Absolute relocation probes return the linked absolute symbol through word sized loads for 64, 32 and narrow 16-bit cases and through multi-instruction wide immediate sequences for signed three-step and unsigned four-step constructions.

Relative probes resolve to a shared mutable symbol sym64_rel via page form with low part addition, short range form, and embedded data offsets in three widths added to the emission address, plus a far page probe of memstart_addr.

Register updates distinguish transport faults from semantic rejection, using EIO for range errors, EINVAL for unsupported features masked bits and invalid combinations without committing state, and EFAULT for user memory faults during import.
Compat hardware breakpoint address reads truncate the internal 64-bit address to low 32 bits, and stores to slot zero succeed without effect, so callers cannot use slot zero for configuration.
